title: GUI-JEPA: Candidate-Conditioned JEPA Latents as a Fast Action Policy for Mobile GUI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.36877v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mobile GUI agents are typically fine-tuned 7B-scale vision-language models (VLMs) that generate each action as text. However, these VLMs decode every action token by token, and even agents that score candidate actions keep a large language model or VLM in the loop, making them slow and memory-hungry. To address these issues, we propose GUI-JEPA, to our knowledge the first decoder-free GUI agent policy built on a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA), which selects actions in the latent space of a JEPA encoder pretrained on unlabelled GUI screenshots. Its action- and region-conditioned latent predictor turns the screen latent into one latent per candidate action, letting lightweight heads score all candidates against the instruction in a single batched pass, without decoding a token. We further show that the scorer relies on this latent pathway and that the predictor is trained for the decision itself: a randomly initialised pred

translated_title: GUI-JEPA：候选条件化的JEPA潜在表示作为移动GUI智能体的快速动作策略
translated_abstract: 移动GUI智能体通常是对70亿参数规模的视觉-语言模型进行微调，以文本形式生成每个动作。然而，这些VLM需要逐token解码每个动作，即使是那些对候选动作进行打分的智能体，也要在决策流程中保留大型语言模型或VLM，导致速度慢且内存消耗大。为解决这些问题，我们提出了GUI-JEPA，据我们所知，这是首个基于联合嵌入预测架构构建的无解码器GUI智能体策略，它在预训练于无标注GUI截图的JEPA编码器的潜在空间中选择动作。其动作和区域条件化的潜在预测器将屏幕潜在表示转换为每个候选动作对应的一个潜在表示，使轻量级打分头能够在一次批量处理中针对指令对所有候选动作进行打分，而无需解码任何token。我们进一步证明，打分器依赖于这一潜在通路，且预测器是为决策本身而训练的：一个随机初始化的预……
tldr: GUI-JEPA是首个无解码器的GUI智能体策略，利用在无标注GUI截图上预训练的JEPA编码器潜在空间，通过候选条件化的潜在预测器和轻量级打分头在一次批量处理中为所有候选动作打分，无需逐token解码，实现了快速且省内存的移动GUI操作。
en_tdlr: GUI-JEPA is the first decoder-free GUI agent policy that scores candidate actions in a single batched pass using a candidate-conditioned JEPA latent predictor and lightweight heads, eliminating token-by-token decoding for fast and memory-efficient mobile GUI control.
